source.stem: What is the correct sequence for blood being pumped from the heart to the lungs?

options.text: left atrium → left ventricle → pulmonary artery
left atrium → left ventricle → pulmonary vein
right atrium → right ventricle → pulmonary artery
right atrium → right ventricle → pulmonary vein

mx.teacher_note: With sunlight from the right, the root bends right and the shoot grows straight upward.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: With sunlight from the right, the shoot bends left and the root grows downward.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: With sunlight from the right, the shoot grows straight upward and the root grows downward.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: In the inverted seedling, the root keeps growing upward and the shoot keeps growing downward.

intelligence.enrichment: Shoots of plants grow upward and move towards sunlight, while roots grow downward. Plant orientation and light direction affect the observed bending of the shoot, but the root still grows downward and the shoot grows upward or towards sunlight. The learner correctly applies this rule: Shoots of plants grow upward and move towards sunlight, while roots grow downward. Roots and shoots keep growing in whichever direction they are already pointing.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Science question. Chapter: Living creatures: exploring their characteristics.
